meta.name: rescate-retrieval-suite
meta.purpose: Measure the retriever (mirror of LegacyRag) independently of any model: does the right chunk surface in topK, and is the decisive sentence inside the 180-char snippet? Issue #14 requires a baseline before changing the term map.
meta.notes: All (source, answer_marker) pairs verified against the current 312-chunk corpus by eval/grading/retrieval_metrics.py validate_corpus — the suite refuses to run if any claim breaks. For Arabic queries the expected behavior exercises the hand-written term map — failures here are exactly what #14 wants quantified.
